title: Custom American Football Close Up on Grunge Vintage Comforter
description:
Transform your space into the ultimate sports-themed sanctuary with the cozy and stylish comforter set from Jeminise. Perfect for football fans, players, and coaches, this custom-designed bedding adds a vibrant, sporty touch to any bedroom, guestroom, or kids' room while offering a soft, lightweight layer of breathable warmth.

Key Features

  • Custom Options: Features personalization support with 2 text inputs for names or numbers to create a truly unique sports-themed bedding set.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping or shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for any bed, with choices including US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Included Components: Each package comes with 1 Duvet Cover (or Comforter) and optional matching pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry on low heat for quick, fluffy results.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Selected Design Vintage Watercolor Football Art
Style Contemporary
Theme Football
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
